name: Tomas Tobé - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union and its Member States, of a Protocol amending the Euro-Mediterranean Aviation Agreement between the European Community and its Member States, of the one part, and the Kingdom of Morocco, of the other part, to take account of the accession to the European Union of the Republic of Croatia
part_text:
Croatia joined the European Union in 2013. It then had to join the air travel agreement the EU made with Morocco. This report gives the European Parliament's approval to a new protocol that adds Croatia to that agreement. The protocol only makes language changes to the agreement so it covers Croatia. The agreement lets all EU airlines fly between the EU and Morocco without being treated unfairly. Croatia will now get the same benefits as the other EU countries.

- Croatia becomes part of the EU's air travel agreement with Morocco.
- EU airlines, including Croatian ones, can fly between the EU and Morocco on equal terms.
- Parliament has approved the protocol; the Council can now conclude it.
